title: Fifth Station: Simon of Cyrene Helps Jesus
text:
Consider how the Jews, seeing that at each step Jesus was weakening and was at the point of expiring. They feared that He would die before He was crucified. So they forced Simon to carry the Cross behind Our Lord.

My Jesus, I will not refuse the Cross as Simon did; I accept it,
I embrace it. I accept in particular the death Thou has chosen
for me, with all the pains which may accompany it; I unite it to Thy
death - I offer it to Thee. Thou hast died for love of me; I will
die for love of Thee, and to please Thee. Help me by Thy grace.
I love Thee, my Jesus; I love Thee more than myself; I am sorry
for having offended Thee. Never let me stray from Thee again.
Grant that I may always love Thee and do Thy will. Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
